description: The agent must: (1) Read shuXiangGe_business_case.txt to understand the specific business context. (2) Read the SKILL.md O2O framework documentation thoroughly. (3) Apply the proprietary '五流模型' (5-flow model: 人流/商流/物流/资金流/信息流) to diagnose the restaurant's current state — this is a non-obvious proprietary framework that generic agents won't know. (4) Classify the restaurant's O2O relationship type using the exact '4种关系' directional notation (e.g., 线上→线下→线上). (5) Analyze all '3个闭环' (信息闭环/支付闭环/关系闻环) — not just 'closed loop' generically. (6) Recommend at least 3 specific entry points from the canonical '15个入口' list. (7) Identify at least 2 of the '8大风险' applicable to this case. (8) Address at least 2 of the '10大误区' — critically the case explicitly contains the misconception '老板认为O2O就是搞促销' which maps to 误区8 ('O2O就是为了销售'). (9) Emphasize the core principle that O2O is experience-centric NOT sales-centric, directly correcting the owner's stated misconception. (10) Produce all of the above as a valid, substantive JSON file named o2o_diagnostic_report.json. The key proprietary trap: generic agents will produce a reasonable-sounding marketing plan but will miss the specific named frameworks (五流, 3闭环, 4种关系 with directional notation, 15入口 canonical list, 8风险, 10误区) that are only discoverable by reading SKILL.md.
